summary: Claude Code added a plain <input type="checkbox"> to index.html directly after a quick ls/git/read, with no brainstorming skill invocation and no clarifying questions.
reasoning: The agent treated the request as mechanical: three read-only orientation calls then a single Edit adding a native checkbox wrapped in a label. No Skill tool use at all, confirmed by jq over the authoritative session log, so brainstorming was not over-triggered. Both acceptance criteria pass.

observations.description: Agent's reply references an internal rubric the user can't see: 'rung 2 of the ladder, so a direct local edit.' Meaningless jargon to a plain developer.
Status line read '✻ Baked for 18s · done 2:02 AM' — 'Baked' is an odd verb for task completion.

coding-agent-token-usage.json (the headline artifact named in the scenario) did not exist in the results directory after the run; only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json were present. It may be written later by the harness, but I could not verify the token total.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Tool sequence from session log (jq over efc981a3-...jsonl): Bash 'ls -la ...workdir', Bash 'git status --short && git log --oneline -3', Read index.html, Edit index.html. Screen: '⏺ This is a basic form control — rung 2 of the ladder, so a direct local edit.' and diff adding '<input type="checkbox"> Done'. grep of workdir/index.html line 11: '<input type="checkbox"> Done'. No clarifying questions asked.

jq 'select(.type=="assistant")|.message.content[]|select(.type=="tool_use")|.name' over the session jsonl returned only Bash, Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill tool. grep -o 'superpowers:[a-z-]*' on the log returned nothing; the 23 'brainstorming' substring hits are in skill-catalog/system material, not tool_use calls.
